21 November – 8 December 2026 · Sunder Nursery, New Delhi

Operational assessments

Production Team

Review food preparation and record observations from the kitchen.

Open production form ↗
Production checks

Check ingredient availability and preparation progress. Review the dishes ready for service and record issues requiring follow-up.

Floor Team

Assess service at the counters and record observations from the floor.

Open floor form ↗
Floor checks

Walk the serving counters. Check queue movement, seating and cleanliness, and flag any stall that needs support.

Closing SOP

Complete the stall assessment after service ends.

Open closing form ↗
Closing checks

Review cleaning, storage and equipment shutdown with the stall team. Record pending issues for the next shift.

Shift guide

Before service

Confirm stall readiness with the Production Team and share any gaps with the floor coordinator.

During peak hours

Coordinate replenishment, billing queues and guest movement between production and floor teams.

After service

Complete the closing assessment for each stall and hand over outstanding items to the next shift.
